name: Editor Advanced Image
description: Enhances the inline-image Dialog in D8 CKEditor.
project_description:
Enhances the image Balloon in CKEditor 4 & CKEditor 5.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 Allows to define the following attributes:

 
 title 
 class 
 id 
 
 You will also be able to:

 
 define a default class for every images on an Editor (such img-fluid or img-responsive ). 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 The 8.x-2.1 branch is compliant with both ckeditor4 & ckeditor5 
 The 3.x branch is compliant with ckeditor5 only 
 
 Back to top 

 Standard usage scenario for CKEditor 5 
 
 Install the module. 
 Open the "Text formats and editor" admin page admin/config/content/formats . 
 Use the "Editor Advanced Image" configuration form to enable any attributes you need ( title , class and/or id ). 
 Only those whitelisted here will be visible in CKEditor 5 Balloon. 
 
 Back to top 

 Standard usage scenario for CKEditor 4 
 
 Install the module. 
 Open the "Text formats and editor" admin page admin/config/content/formats . 
 if the "Limit allowed HTML tags and correct faulty HTML" filter is disabled you don't have anything to do with this text format. 
Otherwise, add the title , class and/or id attributes to the img "allowed HTML tags" field (only those whitelisted will show up in the dialog).
